CSGO has been a very exciting and boring roller coaster trough out my gaming experience. The game was really fun in the beginning with exciting shooting and needed to have a good teamwork to win the game. But when getting up in the hundreds hours of playing the game it starts to get boring because nothing new is added to the game e.g like a new map or gun.
The game developers should definitely reduce of making cases and skins to increase revenue but instead invest their resources into developing and fixing the game to get a better gaming experience for everybody playing.
I think the game is really fun and have a lot of potential but the developers is holding it back.
A lot of people have given feedback on the game but almost nothing has changed, the game is intended for the people and not for the developers right?

This is not intended to insult or target anyone in the gaming community or to the developers, this is just feedback from only my perspective.

Together we can change CSGO

Counter-Strike 2 introduces a variety of fresh elements to the series, offering enjoyment to both seasoned players and newcomers. Notably, the revamped graphics for the maps and firearms stand out. Additionally, several systems represent significant improvements over CS: GO, particularly the Loadout and Smoke Grenade, enhancing the overall experience and fairness of Counter-Strike 2. Nevertheless, the absence of certain features in the game may dissuade some potential players from giving it a try. However, the current features and enhancements are ample to provide a satisfying Counter-Strike experience.

The more I play the more I realize just how incompetent and deaf this company is. If you want a cheater free experience you need to involve a third party website that will have its own better anticheat and a much better PERFORMANCE based ELO system. Still have no implemented original maps from CSGO, cut all community servers, movement and shooting is horrible and performance tanks for no reason. Out of all the glaring issues that plague this game we are rolling out a patch for... ammo economy? They also just could not stand people trading on third party websites (so they could avoid a TWENTY percent sale tax this filth of a company has) so they added terminals where you will have to spend up to steam wallet max(like 1.6k) to purchase a skin in case you actually roll gold. They have no interest in player satisfaction or the state of the game. They are allergic to doing anything that requires a modicum amount of effort and are blind to most glaring issues for over 2 years.

It's still good old Counter-Strike and I like the new features that Source 2 brings (volumetric smoke grenades are very cool). Never liked the washed out colors though, tweak the gamma in the developer console if you want something more vibrant.

P.S. Kelly Bailey did an alternate soundtrack for Counter-Strike as a music kit after leaving Valve, highly recommend it. In fact I think it's the only thing that I've ever paid for in the game.
